title: Wed 21 Oct 2026: Dow rallies as oil swings, UK inflation and Budget countdown, FCA Connect move, Nuveen completes Schroders
summary: The Dow gains more than five hundred points on earnings and falling oil while the FTSE 100 slips again, and Seoul rebounds sharply. UK unemployment falls to four point seven percent ahead of today's September inflation print, with the Budget, the Fed and the ECB to follow. In regulation, fund authorisations move online on the second of November and the transaction reporting timetable comes into focus; in funds, a record year for ETF launches and the completed Nuveen and Schroders deal. Plus three COO action points and the diary.
